Definition: A declared named variable a formula's variable_ref binds to, sourced from solver results or model inputs at check time.
A user-supplied private allowable/limit slot carrying a dimension/unit intent and a value_status rather than an embedded value.
Enum classifying a required input's value source: solver_result, model_input, user_supplied_rule_value, private_library_value, owner_design_basis, TBD.
A four-member reference (library_kind/library_id/record_id/slot_id) pointing at a value held in a private library record, resolved at run time; the value is never embedded (DEC-038).
An in-pack reference carrying a single result_id resolved from the solved result envelope's results[] at run time; canonical form of the {input_id, result_id} solver binding (DEC-039).
A declaration's dimension/unit intent record (dimension, unit_ref, relaxation flags) used for unit and dimension checking.
The uppercase TBD token the codec (decode_quantity) and schema (DimensionId) accept as the honest unknown-dimension/slot-kind placeholder; lowercase tbd fails decode and validation.
The blocking diagnostic raised when an unfilled or unresolvable reference leaves an input unsupplied (never a silent pass).
The frozen grammar v1.0.0 typed AST (DEC-022) that is the sole canonical checksum-bound form of a rule-pack expression.
An AST node binding to a declared required input or value slot id.
A table-backed AST node requiring at least two strictly-increasing rows; the evaluator blocks out-of-range arguments and never extrapolates.
A table-backed AST node carrying an exact or step mode plus a table and a recursive argument expression.
The decision ruling the expression composer purely structured: a read-only one-way AST-to-text preview is permitted but no writable text input and no parser.
The reviewed unit catalog used for unit refs when the desktop backend exposes it; browser preview keeps manual unit text.
The explicit diagnostic reported for backend actions in browser preview where no Tauri runtime exists.
Privacy classification of a new draft rule pack; redistribution_status is private_only.
Draft member asserting software_makes_compliance_claim false and human_review_required true; never a code-compliance claim.
A sha256/JCS canonical checksum stamped into checksums.rule_pack_checksum excluding the checksums member (rfc8785_jcs_sha256).
